## Checklist

- [ ] I opened the link today and it works.
- [ ] It meets every rule for its type in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#inclusion-bar) (stars / activity / license / reproducibility).
- [ ] Numbers in `data/catalog.json` were copied from the source today, not estimated, and `last_checked` is today.
- [ ] `blurb.en`, `blurb.zh-CN` and `blurb.ja` are all filled (machine drafts marked `machine-draft`).
- [ ] I edited only `data/catalog.json` and ran `python3 scripts/generate_readme.py`.
- [ ] No duplicate URL, and the post is not just a pointer to a repo that is already listed.
- [ ] Not a competitor platform, not a promotional post, no "comment/retweet to get it" gate.
- [ ] I did not add ⚡ without a published, tested Token360 guide.
- [ ] Disclosure: I am / am not affiliated with this project.
